shapeSummary: Notional flat-laid starter kit footprint of about 250 x 150 x 30 mm: 8 stadium-shaped HTD belt loops of decreasing length (15 mm wide) in a top row, 2 large hub-mount pulleys (74 mm OD, 20 mm thick, 8 mm bore) at lower right, 8 small aluminum pulleys (20 mm OD, 15 mm wide, 8 mm bore) in a 2x4 grid at lower left, and 8 6 mm OD standoffs along the bottom edge.
warnings: The kit is a multi-piece assortment, not a single part, so the model is a notional layout of simplified primitives.
No dimensions were provided, so all sizes are estimates taken from the image analysis.
The result is a compound of disjoint solids.
Belt teeth, pulley teeth and flanges, hex bores (modeled as round 8 mm), and the large-pulley hole patterns were omitted.
Sonic hubs, bearing idlers, small idlers, shims, screws and hex keys were omitted as too uncertain or too detailed.
The belts are modeled as simple stadium loops that are not to scale with the pulleys.
